fieldNotes.truckGate: 2025 Street View at the dock-apron entrance shows an open paved apron directly off the public road (Henderson Way internal road) with only a 'SHIPPING' directional sign - no barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point lane control.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure anywhere at the apron entrance or office entrance; both are open.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Single dock bank on the east face; ~9 trailers backed in with apron room for several more. Door count estimated at ~16 from trailer spacing and building depth - flagged as a band estimate.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal access road from the SW Henderson Way intersection to the east apron is ~250 m and the apron itself is deep - easily holds a 3+ truck queue off the public road.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs parallel just north of the property but no spur enters the site; the building's north face is grass strip only.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park on the SE side of Plant City FL, bordered by wetland/lakes and farmland - judged Rural per the small-town rule.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No marked trailer-only drop stalls; trailers seen are backed into dock doors.
